caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet with strings attached to its body parts. The puppet has a large head with distinct facial features, including thick black eyebrows, heavy-lidded eyes, a prominent nose, a mustache, and a goatee; its face is pink with some darker shading for contours. The hair is black and extends to about the shoulder. The main body and arms of the puppet are dressed in a red, long-sleeved shirt with light blue rectangular patches on the sleeves and chest. The puppet’s pants are voluminous and black, tucked into blue boots with black soles. The hands are oversized and flesh-toned. To the right of the main view is a side profile drawing of the puppet’s head, showing the same hair, facial features, and coloring. Below the head is a schematic view of the marionette’s wooden control apparatus, which is T-shaped with labeled sections. Several thin black lines, representing the strings, run from attachment points on the puppet’s head, arms, and legs up to corresponding letter and number labels at the top edge of the composition. The background is a plain off-white or beige. The signature “Barnaby Chicheater” is at the lower right, next to the control apparatus diagram.
title: Marionette
